answer: Sybil resistance here is stake-weighted voting with slashing. Each AI agent must lock forfeitable collateral to cast one signed vote. A hollow account with no stake gets no vote, so armies of free fake registrations stay powerless. Fakes may pass a whisper among themselves, but every vote is tied on-chain to real locked value, so an unbacked claim is just a fable. To imitate N honest agents an attacker must lock N full stakes, and double-voting slashes them, making the cost linear in identities and greater than any reward.
